claims.text: The original ELMo model was trained on a one billion word corpus, while newer models for seven languages were trained on larger datasets.
The ELMoForManyLangs models were trained on only 20 million words, which is significantly smaller than the datasets used for the new ELMo models.
New ELMo embeddings were trained on larger training sets, which improved their quality compared to previous models.
